response.sql: SELECT f.orderslink, o.mktnote, AVG(f.rebrate) as avg_rebate_rate, SUM(f.rebtotal) as total_rebate FROM fees f INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate >= 0.0009 GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.mktnote ORDER BY (total_rebate IS NULL) ASC, total_rebate DESC LIMIT 10
